Predictive customer lifetime value (pLTV) uses machine learning to forecast how much revenue each customer is likely to generate across their full relationship with your business. Instead of averaging past behavior across a cohort, predictive LTV looks at each individual’s signals (purchases, engagement patterns, channel preferences, product usage) and projects their future value early in the customer journey, often within their first interactions with your brand. What data is used to predict LTV? Predictive LTV models can pull from any signal that correlates with future spend or retention.
